title: A Heavy Heart Made Brave
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
When Nehemiah heard the news,
His heart sank like a stone.
The walls back home were broken down,
For days he prayed alone.

[Chorus]
When your heart feels heavy and scared,
Just pray, and God will hear.
He turns a heavy heart to brave
And takes away the fear.

[Verse 2]
He asked the king, "May I go home
And build the walls up tall?"
The king said yes! By night he rode
Around each broken wall.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes, the night is still,
Let go of every fear.
The Lord who made his heart so brave
Is right beside you here.

[Chorus]
mood: Nighttime music. A slow, low, steady pulse moves beneath the voice like a quiet ride around broken walls after dark, heavy at first and then growing calm. The chorus lifts gently as a heavy heart turns brave. By the last verse the pulse settles deeper and slower still, all the fear let go, resting in the dark with God near.
